name: Voldaren Estate
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}, Pay 1 life: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a Vampire spell.
{5}, {T}: Create a Blood token. This ability costs {1} less to activate for each Vampire you control. (It's an artifact with "{1}, {T}, Discard a card, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
blocked_sentences: {5}, {T}: Create a Blood token. This ability costs {1} less to activate for each Vampire you control.

needs.what: a mana cost on an *activated* ability that shrinks by {1} for each permanent matching a filter its controller controls, clamped at {0} -- i.e. a scaling generic component on an ability cost, evaluated when the ability is offered and again when it is paid
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Both existing reductions discount *casting a spell*, not activating an ability: a card's `cost_reduction` field is Ghalta's 'this spell costs {X} less to cast', and the `spell_cost_reduction` static discounts other players' spells via `affects_spells`; both are read only from the cast path (`costs.cost_reduction`, called from the cast/legality code). An activated ability's `cost.mana` is a fixed literal mana string with no place for a count-derived term, and `times` in a cost repeats the whole cost rather than scaling its generic part.

notes: Two of the three original needs are now closed. `mana_restriction` accepts a list of creature subtypes, so "Spend this mana only to cast a Vampire spell" is expressible; and a Blood token exists in data/cards/tokens.cards.json. What is left is only the cost reduction on the third line.
